name: Guided Study Tutor & Mindmap
author: Lensetek
description: Structured study tutor with PDF/file ingestion into SQLite, chapter progress tracking, active recall quizzes, flashcards, and interactive SVG mindmap viewer.
description_id: Mode tutor belajar terstruktur dengan ingest PDF/berkas ke SQLite, pelacakan progres bab, kuis active recall, flashcard, dan tampilan mindmap SVG interaktif.
description_cn: 结构化学习导师插件：支持将 PDF/文档导入 SQLite、章节进度追踪、主动回忆测验、抽认卡及交互式 SVG 思维导图。
